utility.notes: Encinitas is a well-documented San Diego County city within SDG&E's core service territory, consistent with SDG&E-territory records established elsewhere this session.

value.name: San Diego Community Power (SDCP)
value.notes: SDCP's own 'Our Community' page confirms it serves Encinitas, alongside San Diego, Chula Vista, Imperial Beach, La Mesa, National City, and unincorporated San Diego County. SDG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

interconnection_url.notes: SDG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) interconnection page, already established for other SDG&E-territory records this session.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Log into the Customer Self Service (CSS) account to schedule the Building inspection

inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Inspections process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited permit review for small solar energy systems
other_conditions: Expedited pathway applies to systems no larger than 10kW for solar PV or 30kW for solar water heating
SolarAPP+ (via NREL) is available for photovoltaic-with-battery-storage permits
All permit submittals go through the Customer Self Service (CSS) portal
